f.t: Literally *like daughters of an ostrich* or *like daughters of an owl*
*Zaanan* sounds like the Hebrew for *come out*.
*Lachish* sounds like the Hebrew term for *team of horses*.
*Moresheth* sounds like the Hebrew for *gift* or *dowry*.
Or *“I will prophesy to you for wine and strong drink”*

w.t: One who breaks open the way

p.x: The Mountain of the House of the LORD

f.t: Or *hill*; Hebrew *And you, Migdal-eder, the Ophel*

w.t: and let us feast our eyes

f.t: Or *in a woodland, in the midst of Carmel*

Forms of the Hebrew *chesed* are translated here and in most cases throughout the Scriptures as *loving devotion*; the range of meaning includes *love*, *goodness*, *kindness*, *faithfulness*, and *mercy*, as well as *loyalty to a covenant*.
